fields.bio:
They say patience wins championships. I say patience wins rookie picks... and rookie picks become dynasties.
I don't chase hype. I collect value. While everyone else is making panic trades at 2 a.m., I'm quietly stacking assets and waiting for the scoreboard to catch up.
Trade with me if you dare. Just know that every deal has hydraulics... and somehow I always end up riding away a little higher.
The Lowrider
Built for the long haul. Rolling over rebuilds since Day 1. 🏆
